data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'bernios', meaning 'bright, illumined'. In the New Testament, Bernice is the name of a noblewoman and sister of Quintus, who was a bishop of Cyprus. Bernice is a symbol of spiritual illumination and enlightenment. The name Berni carries the meaning “Bright, illumined” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berni usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, illumined and live with faith, good character and purpose.
